problem_statement:
PostgreSQL non-superusers cannot read pg_subscription.subwalrcvtimeout.

Unlike the other publicly readable pg_subscription columns, subwalrcvtimeout is not readable by non-superusers. It should have the same public readability as the corresponding public subscription settings.
